verdict.rationale: Sill's Mac host has Settings › Devices, which lists paired devices and lets you remove a lost or unused one, so only paired devices can connect afterward. That covers the revoke half of the story. The evidence only shows a list of paired devices, not who is connected right now, and nothing documents ending a live session from the host. Missing for 10: a live view of currently connected devices on the host, a host-side disconnect for an active session, and independent or hands-on corroboration of device removal.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host

citations.quote: Sill's Settings › Devices on your Mac lists the devices you paired. Remove one you no longer use, or have lost.
You can remove any of them in Sill’s Settings › Devices on your Mac.
After that, only the devices you paired can connect, and every connection is encrypted.
